name: Derelict Highchurch
desc:
The Derelict Highchurch is a location in the East Luminant, it can be found above the [Ancient Rotlands](location:ancient_rotlands). It can be accessed from a broken bridge connecting to near the [Songseeker Temple](location:songseeker_temple) in the [Songseeker Wilds](location:songseeker_wilds), or from two Union Hooks on the backside. Four Songseekers will spawn at the front of the church, which must be killed as a part of [Ezra](entity:ezra)'s quest.

It appears normal on the surface, however, one can open a hatch beneath the lectern, leading into a library, You can interact with some bookcases, to open a secret entrance, or just use a terrain breaking mantra on the bookshelves guarding the entrance to a room with a crucified Celestial, and [Samael](entity:samael), who is crucial to receiving the Starkindred Oath.

The Celestial's blood is also a crucial part of obtaining the Saltchemist Oath. You can also find [Beatra](entity:beatra), a Shadowcast user who acts as the trainer in the overworld. She can be found in the garden to the left of the church (She cannot grant the player Shadowcast however, only to upgrade Mantras).

_For a visual guide, consider watching this gif_ below.

The [Bloodrend Trainer, Vyrelda](entity:vyrelda_master_of_blood), can be found inside of the church itself, between the chairs on the left side.
additional_info:
-   The music for this area is Of Labours, Veiled by Naktigonis, which is the the same track used in places such as [Crypt of the Unbroken](location:crypt_of_the_unbroken), [Duke Erisia's Manor](location:duke_erisias_manor), [Voidheart](location:voidheart), and the [Beloved Zofia](location:beloved_zofia).
-   This location has the largest interactable bookshelves out of anywhere else in the game.
-   This church was originally a spot owned by [Ezra](entity:ezra) to worship Ku, a Celestial that many Capra worship. Until [Samael](entity:samael) kicked them out in pursuit of Starkindred.
